SackJo22.review: The exotic and familiar come together in a uniquely hypnotic mix by Siobhan Dakay whose creative interpretation of Madam Snowflake's song elicits feeling and movement as the music unburies a message from the hearts of these artists.

upload_description_plain:
So I had this time the assignment to do a secret mix of Madam Snowflake. 
What a great pleasure.

The mix I have made is kind of a crossover of oriental sound(intstrumentation) and reggae (drum & bass) with a bit of "drama" added.

I think it fits pretty well to her Vocals that I hopefully have treated with the right portion of respect.

upload_description_plain:
I Dunno by Grapes is one of the most featured Ccmixter remixes in YouTube history.  Even though there is no marketing support for this mix from the industry, it continues to be sourced as a go to bed track for independent productions, once again proving the assertion that creative commons licensing fosters vibrant art culture.  

For Dig the Soundtrack 2017 I chose to dig into the source of Grapes' classic and carve out a bare-bones remix that pays homage to the original.  

Thanks for listening to Ccmixter.  Find more instrumental royalty free tracks at dig.ccmixter.org
